messages:
Anya: quick heads-up — found two dead links in the runtime onboarding guide (model onboarding section).
Ramon: where exactly? can you paste the URLs or a snippet?
Anya: image path 404: https://internal.redwood/runtime/onboard/assets/model-s3.png and an old anchor -> 410 at https://internal.redwood/docs/model-onboard#step-3
Maddie: thanks for catching this. i can pick up the image rehost if no one else has it
Ramon: @Maddie that'd be great. can you also add a redirect from the old slug to the new one?
Maddie: yep. plan: rehost the image to cdn.redwood/team-assets/model-s3-v2.png, update frontmatter, and add a tiny redirect entry in the netlify config. ETA tomorrow AM.
Joel: quick Q — any CI/eval jobs that read that exact path? don't want to accidentally break something that depends on the old URL
Anya: i ran a light grep across runtime CI and eval scripts, nothing referenced that exact asset path. i also checked the nightly runners list — clear.
DocsBot: automated link-scan: /runtime/onboard/assets/model-s3.png -> recommended replacement cdn.redwood/team-assets/model-s3-v2.png (severity: medium)
Ramon: who will own updating the doc anchor and frontmatter canonical? would be nice to include both in the same PR so deploy is atomic
Maddie: i'll update the MD frontmatter (canonical + owner) and fix the broken anchor. adding a redirect in netlify/_redirects as well. pinging @Joel for CR.
Joel: happy to review after standup tomorrow, will check redirect precedence and frontmatter format.
Anya: FYI left a quick note in the page metadata suggesting owner: docs instead of owner: onboarding — small housekeeping change.
Ramon: @Anya can you post an ownership ping in #docs once PR is up so the broader docs custodians are aware?
Anya: will do — i'll include a one-liner in the PR body and tag #docs.
Maddie: WIP PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/1423 — contains image upload, frontmatter tweak, anchor fix, and redirect. comments welcome.
Joel: left two inline comments about redirect ordering and a small nit on the frontmatter key naming.
Maddie: addressed Joel's comments and pushed an update.
Anya: thanks everyone. leaving this thread for async follow-up — flag here if anything slips or if someone needs me to add a changelog entry. :point_up:
Ramon: thanks all :thumbsup:
thread_text_summary: Small triage: dead image + broken anchor in runtime onboarding. Maddy to rehost image, update frontmatter and redirects; Joel to review; Anya to post ownership ping in #docs. PR link included.
